subtitle: Software Engineering Student & Full-Stack Developer

introduction.p1: Welcome to my portfolio! Passionate about computer science and programming, I share here my key projects, developed at university or during my free time.
introduction.p2: From creating scripts to software, including server and data management, my ambition is to transform this passion into expertise, specializing as a Software Engineer / Full Stack Developer.

services.title: REST API
services.p: Developing systems that allow easy information exchange with other services.

services.title: UI/UX Design
services.p: Creating simple, clear, and modern designs so users find what they are looking for in just a few clicks.

services.title: Deployment
services.p: Setting up tools that allow easy updates for a website or app.

projects.title: Website for Dj URYA
projects.name: Dj URYA
projects.desc: This web project allows clients to plan and book a service via a multi-step form with automatic email sending. It integrates a custom CMS with authentication to manage the database and track requests. The admin interface offers complete control over rates, services, and site content.

projects.title: Multiplayer Strategic Board Game
projects.name: Conquete
projects.desc: Creation of a strategic board game in Java, integrating an AI for local multiplayer games, save management, and generation of statistical graphs for the games.

projects.title: Air Traffic Simulator
projects.name: Aerien
projects.desc: This software engineering project is a real-time air traffic simulator designed to automatically model and manage aircraft movements and airport operations. It simulates complex scenarios including multiple flights, real-time flight paths, collision risk management, and unforeseen events such as aviation emergencies.

projects.title: Student Attendance Tracking System
projects.name: Presence
projects.desc: This database and networking project is an automated attendance tracking system designed to model and manage student attendance in real-time within an institution. It simulates complex scenarios of badge identification and network communication via a client-server architecture, integrating SQL query management and live error cases.

projects.title: Educational Application for Students
projects.name: learnpy
projects.desc: Development of an interactive Python application to teach programming to students. The application includes a code editor, real-time feedback generation, and storage of student statistics.

projects.title: Online Tournament Generator
projects.name: Tournois
projects.desc: This React development project is an instant tournament manager designed to efficiently model and orchestrate competitions between multiple participants. It integrates automatic tournament tree generation algorithms, real-time score tracking, and data import/export modules to save and load existing tournaments in one click.
